name: evolvingresonantcocreationism.com
description: The Luminous Library - A philosophy for consciousness-first living and human-AI co-evolution

scripts.serve:watch: python -m http.server 8000 & echo 'Server running at http://localhost:8000'
scripts.validate: npm run test && echo '✅ All validations passed!'
scripts.validate:html: echo '🔍 Validating HTML files...' && find . -name '*.html' -not -path './node_modules/*' -exec echo 'Checking: {}' \;
scripts.lighthouse:local: npm run serve & sleep 2 && npx lighthouse http://localhost:8000 --view
scripts.precommit: npm run format && npm run validate
scripts.info: echo '📚 The Luminous Library' && echo 'Version:' && npm version && node --version

author: Tristan Stoltz & Sophia
